reviews.text: Finding her has been a real discovery! After much searching and visits to many veterinarians, we found a guide who integrates traditional medicine with natural approaches, which for us was the perfect balance. She is incredibly kind and caring, and Melania is a truly loving veterinarian. We are so grateful for the support and follow-up she provides for our kitten.

We are truly grateful to Melania for her patience and step-by-step support. We had been to several veterinarians who gave us some pretty discouraging diagnoses, but with her, we started a new treatment and diet, and our cat hasn't stopped improving. I highly recommend going!
Our experience with our dog has been very positive. Her mobility and digestive issues have improved significantly with her diet, natural supplements, and acupuncture. We're very happy!
A very nice and professional doctor. And thanks to her all-natural remedies, my kitty is much better with his asthma! Highly recommended! 😻 …

One of the worst places you'll find. I've been trying to contact them since Sunday, and I understand that they might be closed on a Sunday, but on a Monday, when their opening hours are listed, and they don't answer me? That's incredibly unprofessional. It would make anyone not want to spend their money on a place that completely ignores you. I absolutely do not recommend them.
The diet Melania created for my cat restored her intestinal balance in a week. Plus, Cleo loves her new food!

I brought my sick cat in with high blood pressure, a thyroid problem, and excess weight. She'd been to the vet several times, but they couldn't find any solutions. Melania created a special diet with complete nutritional supplements, and it completely changed my cat's life and health. I'm so grateful... Thank you so much 🙏🏼 …

I only have words of gratitude for Melania. She's a sweetheart (caring, attentive, and empathetic) and a true professional. My dog ​​has idiopathic epilepsy and is on antiepileptic medication, but I noticed he was very tired, so I decided to go to a holistic veterinarian, and I was incredibly lucky to find Melania. She created a personalized diet for him, prescribed supplements, and gave him acupuncture. He was sleeping very little and was very stressed. Today, he's active again and sleeping well. Thank you so much, Melania, for the peace of mind you give me knowing that Meruem is in the best hands.
We love the Ozone therapy she gives! We will continue to use her service and recommend it! The ozone is truly the ultimate best for my dogs ans she knows the correct technique to administer it!

I'm speechless. 10 out of 10. My dog ​​had digestive problems; he would get nauseous in the early morning and upon waking, sometimes even panting in the middle of winter. I went to two different vets, who gave me all sorts of pills, completely ineffective dietary recommendations, and countless visits that solved nothing and only resulted in me spending a fortune without seeing any improvement in my dog. I went to Melania after I started looking for vets with the best reviews, and honestly, it was the best decision I could have made. Between vets and everything else, my dog ​​was nauseous for three months, he wouldn't let us sleep, and he was starting to seem lethargic. With Melania, I got a diet 100% focused on my dog, no empty, unfounded recommendations, just NATURAL vitamins and supplements. My dog's progress was noticeable within two weeks, and now he's in perfect health and no longer has those nighttime nausea episodes. The moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels calm and peaceful. The way they treat dogs is wonderful, and you won't need to be in the consultation room for more than 10 minutes to know you're in good hands. Highly recommended!
